title: Feincraft
description: Adds oxygen to the game as well as other random changes.
body:
Feincraft is a mod that aims to slow player progression down and change the game to be more fun in random ways without adding new things.

Warning: this mod is very unbalanced and probably unstable. don't take it too seriously.

Some things it adds/changes (not everything!):
- Oxygen mechanic
  - You now have 300 seconds of oxygen and always lose oxygen
  - You regain oxygen by being near a smelting furnace that has no blocks above it (3x3 must be clear up to build limit)
  - Craftable oxygen item
    - 8 copper ingots
- Changed shields
  - Shields now passively block 1 hit and are then disabled for 10 seconds (30 seconds if hit with axe)
- Buffed fishing
  - Fishing always gives an enchanted book with a single level 1 enchant
- Riptide tridents buffed
  - All drowneds have tridents (and nautilus shells)
- Disabled the End
  - Ender eyes now teleport you to the nether when used
- Spyglass buffed
  - Calls an airstrike where it's used
- Lots of recipes added/changed
  - Anvil
    - Iron ingots instead of iron blocks
  - End crystal
    - Ender pearl instead of ender eye
    - Glass instead of ghast tear
  - Ender eye
    - Ender pearl surrounded by 8 diamonds
  - Experience bottle
    - Empty bottle + lapis
  - Firework rocket
    - Gives 1 instead of 3
  - Glowstone
    - 4 torches
  - Hopper
    - Cobblestone instead of iron
  - Netherite armour
    - Now crafted in a crafting table with netherite ingots the same as other armour
  - Respawn anchor
    - Regular obsidian instead of crying obsidian
  - Shield
    - 1 plank surrounded by 8 iron
  - Shulker box
    - Nautilus shells instead of shulker shells
  - Spyglass
    - Glass surrounded by 8 diamonds
  - Totem
    - Gold block surrounded by 8 gold ingots
- A lot more!
